The latest Quinnipiac University showed Trump's approval rating at 32%, while 58% of respondents said they disapproved of the president's job performance. According to the pollster, Trump’s performance in the poll is the worst recorded in either of his terms in the White House. Nearly half the voters surveyed also said they are "worse off financially" then they were one year ago and 88% said they feel inflation is a very serious or somewhat serious problem. [...] The latest figures include 26% of U.S. voters who "strongly approve" of the job Trump is doing as president as well as 46% of voters who "strongly disapprove," according to the report.
